LanguageData.Gun_Tec-9_RWP.label: Tec-9
LanguageData.Gun_Tec-9_RWP.description: The Tec-9 is a compact submachine gun notable for its high rate of fire, making it effective in close-quarters combat. Though less accurate than its larger counterparts, it compensates with rapid bursts of bullets, overwhelming targets with sheer volume. Easy to manufacture and maintain, it's a popular choice among improvised militias and raider gangs.
